name: Homelable
description: Homelable 3.5.1 is a self-hosted homelab diagram with live status monitoring.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Secret key
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
services:
  homelable:
    image: ghcr.io/pouzor/homelable-frontend:3.5.1@sha256:d307875b5afe484f5f082170af829b10259b07676e29e142c0de07ebc5cbba04
    container_name: homelable
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - backend
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:80"
    environment:
      BACKEND_UPSTREAM: backend:8000
  backend:
    image: ghcr.io/pouzor/homelable-backend:3.5.1@sha256:54dfa4b12843f0098141260e75e863a9638ced535a1618cd7b8826bf1718dd62
    container_name: homelable-backend
    restart: unless-stopped
    cap_add:
      - NET_RAW
    environment:
      SECRET_KEY: ${SECRET_SECRET_KEY}
      SQLITE_PATH: /app/data/homelab.db
      CORS_ORIGINS: '["http://localhost:20033"]'
      AUTH_MODE: local
      AUTH_USERNAME: admin
      AUTH_PASSWORD_HASH: "$$2y$$12$$.578Mwn8ZZsSrG.o1.zDR.N3sIHeeLWcXOQsfeT1v5l9Vz2zqMJTi"
      SCANNER_RANGES: "[]"
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data:/app/data
notes: Replace AUTH_PASSWORD_HASH with a bcrypt hash of your own password before the first start. The shipped hash is public. CasaOS and ZimaOS edit that literal; they do not substitute Compose variables. Open http://localhost:20033 and sign in as admin. If you open Homelable by another hostname or IP, add that origin to CORS_ORIGINS. Set SCANNER_RANGES to your LAN CIDR before scanning. On the Docker bridge, scans do not return MAC addresses. Host networking would, and it is Linux-only, so it is not enabled here. Host port 3000 is already used, so this listing publishes 20033. The frontend proxies /api to the backend service, which must keep the name backend.
